notes.title: SX5 x War Child
notes.content:
[b]SX5 supports War Child[/b] in the Game Action Sale but it's not the only one! Between 16-23 August, we’ll donate a % of every sale of Milestone Anthology. 
 
Money raised will help fund their vital work supporting children living in war zones.

notes.title: New DLCs available!
notes.content:
Double the fun with these brand new DLCs for Supercross5! Suzuki, Yamaha, KTM, Kawasaki, Honda, GasGas, and Husqvarna: choose the theme of your favorite motorbike manufacturer and customize your profile, menu, and game elements with the Allegiance Pack. And with the Neon Pack, you have fantastic multicolored neon lights for your bike!

notes.title: eSX eSport Championship is here!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=mTlRu8vwVs8;full][/previewyoutube]
The second edition of the eSX eSport Championship presented by Yamaha is here! Compete against the best to prove you are the ultimate eSX champion and you can win a Yamaha Motorcycle. Register now on Battlefly.com/eSX and discover more

notes.title: Legends Pack Vol. 1 out now!
notes.content:
The good times are back! Relive the excitement of the past with the Legends Pack Vol. 1! There are five legendary riders, including Jeremy McGrath, Ricky Johnson, Jeff Stanton, Kevin Windham, Jeff Ward and a track inspired by the historic Pontiac Silverdome 2002, where you can race back in time. Buy it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725050/Monster_Energy_Supercross_5__Legends_Pack_Vol_1/
